meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速探查科学数据文件，找出缺失值、异常并生成探索报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到新数据集想先全面摸底,再决定如何处理与分析
copy.tagline_en: Inspect your scientific datasets for missing values, outliers, and key patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if in need of a quick data sanity check before deeper analysis

howto.what: 当用户要求分析科学数据文件时，Claude 会先判断文件类型，再检查其结构、统计与数据质量，输出一份 Markdown 报告，含关键发现与建议。不支持的格式则不会分析。
howto.when: 当用户给出科学数据文件的路径，或要求“分析/探索/总结”某个数据文件，或需要做缺失值/泄漏审计时触发。只处理明确支持的科学格式，如 CSV/FASTQ/HDF5 等。

say.text: 帮我分析 data.csv 的结构和数据质量。
say.note: 会生成一份 Markdown EDA 报告。

say.text: 对 sample.fastq 做探索性分析，统计读长和质量。
say.note: 会输出序列统计与质量指标。

say.text: 检查这份 profiles.csv 的缺失值和泄漏问题。
say.note: 会审计缺失/泄漏并给出预处理建议。

howto.what_en: When asked to analyze a scientific data file, Claude detects its type, inspects structure/statistics/data quality, then writes a Markdown EDA report with key findings and suggestions. Unsupported formats are declined.
howto.when_en: Triggered by a scientific file path, a request to analyze/explore/summarize a data file, or a missingness/leakage audit. Only supported formats like CSV/FASTQ/HDF5 are handled.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv structure and data quality.
say_en.note: It will generate a Markdown EDA report.

say_en.text: Explore sample.fastq, give read length and quality stats.
say_en.note: Outputs sequence statistics and quality metrics.

say_en.text: Check profiles.csv for missing values and leakage.
